title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) — Sticky Header & Footer Protection
description: When any user interface component receives keyboard focus (:focus-visible), the component must not be entirely hidden due to author-created content such as sticky headers, fixed bottom navigation bars, cookie consent banners, or floating chat widgets. Mandatory under the European Accessibility Act (EAA) and WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
playwright_check_snippet: const focused = document.activeElement; if (!focused || focused === document.body) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const rect = focused.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2; const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2; const topEl = document.elementFromPoint(cx, cy); const isVisible = topEl && (focused === topEl || focused.contains(topEl) || topEl.contains(focused)); return isVisible ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Inspect the screenshot during keyboard Tab navigation. Verify whether the currently focused element (with focus ring) is partially or completely covered by a sticky header, sticky footer, floating chat button, or cookie modal.
remediation_guide: Set `scroll-padding-top` and `scroll-padding-bottom` on the root scroll container (`html`) equal to the height of fixed/sticky toolbars (e.g., `html { scroll-padding-top: 80px; scroll-padding-bottom: 64px; }`) so the browser automatically scrolls focused controls clear of fixed overlays during Tab navigation.

title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced) — Zero Overlap of Focused Component
description: When an interactive component receives keyboard focus, no part of the component or its focus indicator may be hidden by author-created fixed or sticky overlays (0% occlusion). Exceptions apply only to user-opened panels or movable toolbars that can be dismissed via the Escape key without moving focus.
playwright_check_snippet: const el = document.activeElement; if (!el || el === document.body) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const pts = [[r.left+2, r.top+2], [r.right-2, r.top+2], [r.left+2, r.bottom-2], [r.right-2, r.bottom-2]]; const allClear = pts.every(([x,y]) => { const hit = document.elementFromPoint(x,y); return hit && (el === hit || el.contains(hit) || hit.contains(el)); }); return allClear ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Check all four corners of the active keyboard focus indicator on the screenshot. Confirm that zero pixels of the focused control or its outline are obscured by fixed toolbars, FABs, or persistent banners.
remediation_guide: Apply generous `scroll-margin-block` on interactive elements accounting for `outline-offset` (e.g., `:focus-visible { scroll-margin-block: 96px; }`) and ensure any non-modal floating banners can be dismissed with the `Escape` key.

title: Focus Appearance — Minimum 2px Perimeter & >= 3.0:1 Contrast Change
description: The keyboard focus indicator (:focus-visible) must enclose the component with an area at least as large as a 2 CSS px thick perimeter and provide at least a 3.0:1 contrast ratio between its focused and unfocused states, as well as >= 3.0:1 contrast against adjacent background colors.
playwright_check_snippet: const el = document.activeElement; if (!el || el === document.body) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const cs = window.getComputedStyle(el); const outlineWidth = parseFloat(cs.outlineWidth) || 0; const hasBoxShadow = cs.boxShadow && cs.boxShadow !== 'none'; return (cs.outlineStyle !== 'none' && outlineWidth >= 2) || hasBoxShadow ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Examine the focused interactive element. Verify that a clearly visible, high-contrast (>= 3:1) focus ring of at least 2px thickness surrounds the control and works on both light and dark backgrounds.
remediation_guide: Never apply `outline: none` without a high-contrast replacement. Use a dual-ring focus indicator: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #005FCC; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #FFFFFF; }`, guaranteeing >= 3.0:1 contrast over any light or dark surface.

title: Dragging Movements — Single-Pointer Alternative Required
description: All functionality that uses a dragging movement for operation (kanban boards, sortable lists, price range sliders, map panning, color pickers, carousels) must be achievable by a single pointer without dragging (e.g., single-click/tap buttons, position dropdowns, or direct numeric text inputs).
playwright_check_snippet: const draggables = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[draggable="true"], input[type="range"], [role="slider"]')); if (draggables.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const hasControls = draggables.every(el => el.tagName === 'INPUT' || document.querySelector('[aria-controls], button[data-move], input[type="number"]')); return hasControls ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Check if the page contains sliders, range filters, kanban cards, sortable lists, or interactive maps. If none exist, return DOES_NOT_APPLY. If present, verify that explicit single-tap/click alternatives exist (e.g., numeric min/max text inputs next to price sliders, up/down/move-to buttons on draggable cards, or +/- pan buttons on maps).
remediation_guide: Pair all `input[type='range']` and custom sliders with linked `<input type='number'>` fields or step increment buttons (`-` / `+`). For drag-and-drop cards and sortable lists, provide a single-click action menu ('Move up / Move down / Move to column...').

title: Target Size (Minimum) — 24x24 CSS Pixels Floor
description: The size of the target for pointer inputs on any interactive control (buttons, icon controls, checkboxes, pagination links, close buttons) must be at least 24x24 CSS pixels, except for inline links within sentences or where a 24px spacing circle Around the target center does not intersect any other target.
playwright_check_snippet: const targets = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a[href], input, select, textarea, [role="button"], [role="checkbox"], [role="tab"]')).filter(el => { const s = getComputedStyle(el); return s.display !== 'none' && s.visibility !== 'hidden' && s.display !== 'inline'; }); if (!targets.length) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const undersized = targets.filter(el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && (r.width < 24 || r.height < 24); }); return undersized.length === 0 ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Inspect all icon buttons, close ('X') buttons, pagination controls, checkboxes, and filter chips. Identify any tightly packed or tiny hit targets that appear smaller than 24x24px without sufficient spacing.
remediation_guide: Enforce `min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px;` on all interactive targets (`44px` recommended per Apple HIG / `48px` per Material 3). If the visual icon is smaller (`16x16px`), expand its hit area using `padding` or `::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; }`.

title: Consistent Help — Predictable DOM & Visual Placement
description: If a web page provides help mechanisms (human support contact details, phone, email, FAQ link, live chat widget, or self-service support link), they must occur in the same relative DOM and visual order across all pages of the application.
playwright_check_snippet: const helpLinks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('header a, footer a, [aria-label*="Help" i], [aria-label*="Support" i], [href*="help"], [href*="support"], [href*="faq"], [href^="tel:"], [href^="mailto:"]')); return helpLinks.length > 0 ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'DOES_NOT_APPLY';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Locate any Help, Support, Contact Us, FAQ link, or Chat widget in the header, footer, or bottom-right corner. Verify that it is clearly visible, not obscured, and placed in a standard, predictable global landmark region.
remediation_guide: Place the Help/Support link or chat widget inside a shared global `<header>` or `<footer>` layout component in a fixed DOM position so its `Tab` order remains consistent across page transitions and zoom levels up to 200%.

title: Redundant Entry — Auto-Populate or Reuse Session Data
description: Information previously entered by or provided to the user within the same multi-step session (such as shipping address reused for billing address, or user name/phone across checkout steps) must be either auto-populated or available for single-click selection (e.g., 'Billing address same as shipping').
playwright_check_snippet: const forms = document.querySelectorAll('form'); if (forms.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const inputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input:not([type="hidden"]):not([type="submit"]):not([type="checkbox"]):not([type="radio"])')); if (inputs.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const withAutocomplete = inputs.filter(i => i.hasAttribute('autocomplete') && i.getAttribute('autocomplete') !== 'off'); return withAutocomplete.length / inputs.length >= 0.7 ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: If the page contains a checkout, registration, or multi-step form, check whether billing/shipping or repeated user details offer a 'Same as shipping address' checkbox or pre-populated values. If no form is present, return DOES_NOT_APPLY.
remediation_guide: Persist form state in `sessionStorage` or your state store across wizard steps, default the `'Billing address same as shipping'` checkbox to checked, and bind standard HTML `autocomplete` tokens (`name`, `email`, `tel`, `shipping street-address`).

title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum) — Allow Paste, Autocomplete & Passkeys
description: Authentication flows must not require cognitive function tests (memorizing passwords without password-manager support, or solving arithmetic/text puzzles). Password and OTP inputs must permit clipboard paste (`paste`), declare proper `autocomplete="current-password webauthn"` / `autocomplete="one-time-code"`, and support passwordless WebAuthn/Passkeys, Magic Links, or OAuth.
playwright_check_snippet: const pwdInputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="password"]')); if (pwdInputs.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const valid = pwdInputs.every(el => { const ac = el.getAttribute('autocomplete') || ''; const blocksPaste = el.getAttribute('onpaste') === 'return false'; return !blocksPaste && (ac.includes('password') || ac.includes('webauthn')); }); return valid ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: If a login, sign-up, or authentication form is visible, verify whether it supports password managers, 'Show/Hide password' toggle, and alternative cognitive-free login options (Passkey, Sign in with Google/Apple, or Magic Link). If no auth form exists, return DOES_NOT_APPLY.
remediation_guide: Remove any `onpaste="return false"` or `e.preventDefault()` paste listeners on password and OTP inputs. Set `autocomplete="username webauthn"` and `autocomplete="current-password"`, add a password visibility toggle button, and support WebAuthn/Passkeys.

title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced) — No Object-Recognition CAPTCHA Puzzles
description: Authentication must not require users to recognize objects in images (e.g., selecting all squares containing traffic lights or bicycles) or solve visual/audio puzzles. Bot mitigation must rely on passive cryptographic attestation (WebAuthn Passkeys, Private Access Tokens, or OAuth2).
playwright_check_snippet: const authForms = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="password"], form[action*="login"], form[action*="auth"]'); if (authForms.length === 0) return 'DOES_NOT_APPLY'; const hasImageGridPuzzle = document.querySelector('[title*="recaptcha challenge" i], .captcha-image-grid'); return hasImageGridPuzzle ? 'VIOLATED_FAIL' : 'APPLIED_PASS';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Inspect any login or registration screen. Verify that users are not forced to solve visual object-recognition puzzles or distorted text CAPTCHAs. If no authentication screen is present, return DOES_NOT_APPLY.
remediation_guide: Replace interactive visual CAPTCHA puzzles with cryptographic device attestation (Private Access Tokens, WebAuthn Passkeys) or passive server-side risk scoring.

title: Reflow at 320 CSS px Without Horizontal Scrolling
description: At a viewport width of 320 CSS pixels (equivalent to 400% browser zoom on a 1280px desktop screen), all content and functionality must reflow into a single vertical column without requiring two-dimensional (horizontal + vertical) scrolling and without clipping text or buttons.
playwright_check_snippet: const docWidth = document.documentElement.clientWidth; const scrollWidth = document.documentElement.scrollWidth; return scrollWidth <= docWidth + 1 ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Evaluate the 320x568 viewport screenshot. Check if any cards, headings, tables, or buttons overflow off the right edge of the screen or collide with adjacent elements.
remediation_guide: Replace fixed pixel widths (`width: 400px`) with fluid sizing (`width: 100%; max-width: 400px`), use `flex-wrap: wrap`, `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr))`, and apply `overflow-wrap: break-word` to long headings and URLs.

title: Text Spacing Resilience (1.5x Line, 2x Paragraph, 0.12em Letter, 0.16em Word)
description: When a user overrides text spacing (line height to 1.5x font size, paragraph spacing to 2.0x font size, letter spacing to 0.12em, and word spacing to 0.16em), no loss of content or functionality may occur due to overlapping lines or vertical text clipping inside fixed-height containers (`overflow: hidden`).
playwright_check_snippet: const style = document.createElement('style'); style.id = 'wcag-1412-probe'; style.textContent = '* { line-height: 1.5 !important; letter-spacing: 0.12em !important; word-spacing: 0.16em !important; } p { margin-bottom: 2em !important; }'; document.head.appendChild(style); const clipped = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('p, h1, h2, h3, button, a, span')).filter(el => { const cs = getComputedStyle(el); return (cs.overflow === 'hidden' || cs.overflowY === 'hidden') && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 2; }); style.remove(); return clipped.length === 0 ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Inspect buttons, badges, navigation links, and card titles when text spacing is expanded. Verify that no text is vertically clipped or overlapping adjacent lines.
remediation_guide: Avoid fixed heights with hidden overflow on text containers and buttons (`height: 36px; overflow: hidden`). Use `min-height: 44px; height: auto; padding-block: 0.5rem;` and relative `rem`/`em` units.

title: Contrast Minimum (>= 4.5:1 Normal Text, >= 3.0:1 Large Text & UI Components)
description: The visual presentation of normal text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3.0:1 for large text >= 18pt/24px or >= 14pt/18.66px bold). Interactive form borders, icons, and state indicators (WCAG 1.4.11) must maintain at least a 3.0:1 contrast ratio against adjacent surfaces.
vision_prompt_heuristic: Check placeholder text inside inputs, secondary captions, badges, and input borders in both light and dark modes. Flag any low-contrast gray-on-gray text or barely visible form field borders.
remediation_guide: Use semantic design tokens verified for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (at least `#595959` on `#FFFFFF` white background for body/secondary text and `#767676` minimum for input borders and icons).

title: WCAG 3.0 Draft Maturity Scoring (Bronze, Silver, Gold & Holistic Task Flows)
description: Aligned with the W3C Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 3.0 Working Draft, conformance is evaluated across holistic user journeys using weighted outcome tiers: Bronze requires zero critical legal blockers (0 CRITICAL_LEGAL_EAA_ADA failures), Silver requires >= 90% pass rate across ergonomic and cognitive rules, and Gold requires >= 98% compliance including sensory and neurodiversity adaptations.
playwright_check_snippet: const hasMain = !!document.querySelector('main, [role="main"]'); const hasTitle = document.title && document.title.trim().length > 0; const hasLang = !!document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang'); return (hasMain && hasTitle && hasLang) ? 'APPLIED_PASS' : 'VIOLATED_FAIL';
vision_prompt_heuristic: Perform a holistic WCAG 3.0 visual audit: verify clear landmark structure, absence of cognitive traps, high perceptual contrast (APCA readiness), and clear task progression.
remediation_guide: Eliminate all `CRITICAL_LEGAL_EAA_ADA` violations to reach the baseline `BRONZE` tier, implement user-preference media queries (`prefers-reduced-motion`, `prefers-contrast`, `prefers-color-scheme`) for `SILVER`, and validate end-to-end keyboard/screen-reader task flows for `GOLD`.
